name: Chest-Supported Reverse Fly
research: Bench 30 deg, rot_z 180 so the back pad rises toward -Y (he faces -Y and leans onto it; seat is behind him toward +Y). Pad top surface P(s) = (0, -0.01-0.866s+0.019, 0.4025+0.5s+0.032), normal n=(0,0.5,0.866). Root rot X +60: spine runs (0,-0.866,0.5) = along the pad, chest faces -n. Pelvis joint at s=0.30 plus 0.17 m along n (chest front ~0.17-0.19 m ahead of the pelvis joint): (0,-0.251,0.585)+(0,0.085,0.147) = (0,-0.166,0.732); shoulders reach s~0.77 of 0.84, chin past the top (ACE). Measure with probe_bench (pose names differ, so it may need 'bottom') and slide root along n to a -0.02..+0.02 chest gap.. LEGS (12 Nov fix; old straddle splayed the knees to the floor): knees on the seat, the bench's other common set-up (Sweat: 'knees resting on the seat or feet planted on either side'). FK check with the 30 deg pad and the seat boxes: a feet-on-floor stance under the hips cannot clear the pad without the thighs splaying 40+ deg, so kneel. Hip (+-0.11,-0.194,0.689) -> knee (0.105,0.218,0.49) on the seat (thigh 0.457, 25 deg knee bend, thigh clears the pad by 3.4 cm) -> ankle (0.10,0.666,0.4685): shin lies on the seat top (0..-5 mm), feet hang past the seat end, toes down-back (rot X 120). Knee pole straight below (world). Lowest body point is now the toes (~0.25-0.3 m), on purpose. Camera yaw -50 / pitch 35 (front-right, high): arms spread across the picture instead of pointing at the lens, and the back faces the camera.
